name.label: Product Name
name.description: The name should be concise and descriptive. It will help customers easily identify the product

description.label: Description
description.description: Include the features, benefits, and usage instructions of the product in the description. This will provide customers with more information about the product

short_description.label: Short Description
short_description.description: Include the main features and benefits of the product in the short description. This will help customers quickly understand the product

images.label: Images
images.description: Upload images of the product. Include multiple images to showcase the product from different angles

specifications.label: Specifications
specifications.description: Give the specifications of the product

key.label: Specification Key
key.description: Give the key of the specification

value.label: Specification Value
value.description: Give the value of the specification

status.label: Active Status
status.description: Indicate whether the product is currently active and available for purchase

variants.title: Product Variants
variants.description: Define product variant groups (e.g. Size, Color) and options with custom price adjustments and stock.
variants.no_variants: No variants added yet. Click 'Add Variant' to create product variants.

is_mandatory.label: Mandatory Variant
is_mandatory.description: Customer must choose an option for this variant

name.min: Product name must be at least 10 characters long

slug.min: Slug must be at least 10 characters long

description.min: Product description must be at least 10 characters long

short_description.min: Short description must be at least 10 characters long
